description: List the label sizes the given delivery services can print — the values accepted by get_order_delivery_labels' label_format. Per service, `mode` says how it treats sizes: EXPLICIT_FORMATS (pick one of `formats`), PROVIDER_DEFAULT (size ignored, the service prints its own) or NOT_SUPPORTED (no labels at all, `formats` empty). `preselected` is only the size preselected in the KIT UI — it does NOT apply when label_format is omitted. Services come back in the platform's own display order, so look one up by `delivery_service`, not by position.

delivery_service.description: Delivery services to report sizes for; duplicates are ignored by the API. A chunk's service is in get_order under delivery_chunks[].delivery_info.delivery_service_type.

name: get_delivery_label_formats
title: Get delivery label formats
